headline: Brazil industry body petitions Supreme Court to lift glyphosate freeze
summary: Brazil's National Confederation of Industry (CNI) asked the Supreme Court to overturn a 90-day judicial freeze on new glyphosate pesticide approvals.
why: Brazil is the world's largest exporter of soybeans and a leading agricultural producer reliant on agrochemicals.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Pesticide availability directly impacts crop yields and agribusiness revenues in Brazil.
